title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 — Alarmy Changed My Mornings and Nights! The Best Alarm App Ever 🌙⏰
body:
I can’t believe how much Alarmy has changed my life — both my mornings and my nights. I’ve tried dozens of alarm apps before, but nothing ever worked like this one. I used to sleep through alarms, hit snooze ten times, and start every day feeling rushed and stressed. But with Alarmy, I actually wake up on time, feel energized, and even sleep better at night.

🌄 My Mornings Are Completely Different

Now, waking up feels easy. Alarmy doesn’t let you snooze endlessly — it makes you do something before it stops ringing. You can choose “missions” like solving math problems, taking a picture of a specific place (like your bathroom or kitchen), shaking your phone, or even doing memory games. It sounds funny, but it’s genius. You literally can’t turn off the alarm without waking your brain up.

Before I knew it, I was out of bed, alert, and already smiling at how clever it was. I’ve never been a morning person, but now I actually enjoy getting up.

🌙 Better Nights Too — White Noise + Sleep Timer = Perfect Combo

What I didn’t expect was how Alarmy would also improve my nights. It’s not just about waking up — it also helps you fall asleep peacefully. There’s a built-in white noise feature with tons of relaxing sounds like rain, ocean waves, crackling fires, soft piano, and more. I usually choose gentle rain or forest sounds, and it instantly helps me relax.

Even better, you can set a timer so the white noise stops automatically after a while. That means I don’t have to worry about turning it off or wasting battery — I just set it, close my eyes, and drift off peacefully. It’s honestly one of my favorite parts of the app because it makes bedtime feel calm and cozy.

I used to scroll on my phone or overthink before sleeping, but now I put on my Alarmy sound, set the timer, and fall asleep so much faster. And since I know Alarmy will wake me up no matter what, I go to bed relaxed instead of anxious.

⏰ Customizable and Fun

Another thing I love is how personalized everything is. You can pick your alarm tone, volume, difficulty level, and even combine missions for a bigger challenge. You can create different alarms for weekdays, weekends, or naps, and set how long snoozes last. I even made a routine where I have to shake my phone 30 times and solve math problems before it turns off — it sounds crazy, but it totally works.

🧘 Morning Routine Mode = Productive Days

The “Morning Routine” mode is like having a little life coach in your pocket. It lets you plan your ideal start to the day — from brushing your teeth to stretching, journaling, or drinking water. The app gently guides you through each step so you begin your day feeling focused and accomplished. It’s one of those small habits that makes a huge difference over time.

💪 For Heavy Sleepers (and Procrastinators)

If you’re a deep sleeper, this app is your savior. It’s powerful, loud, and smart enough to make sure you actually wake up. I used to think nothing could make me stop hitting snooze — but Alarmy did. It’s perfect for students, busy people, or anyone who wants to get their mornings under control.

💎 Premium Is Totally Worth It

The free version is already amazing, but the Premium upgrade unlocks even more sounds, missions, and features. I went for it, and it’s 100% worth it. It’s honestly such a small price for how much peace, structure, and energy it brings to your days (and nights).

🌟 Final Thoughts

Alarmy isn’t just an alarm clock — it’s a complete sleep and wake-up system. It helps you go to bed relaxed, fall asleep to peaceful sounds, and wake up refreshed and motivated. It changed my whole routine for the better.

If you struggle to get up in the morning, stay asleep peacefully, or want to build a better routine, this is the app you need. It’s smart, effective, and even fun to use.

La aplicación es muy intuitiva y eficiente a la hora de establecer alarmas, ya que te deja incluso copiar alarmas o poner una alarma de forma más rápida. 

Por otro lado los tonos de alarma que incluyen en la versión gratuita son bastante malos pero quizá es más por gustos personales.

La razón por la que instale la app en mi primer teléfono IOS fue que la alarma de este sistema operativo es extremadamente simple y poco útil, además la razón principal fue que cuando la alarma suena para despertarte suena directamente al máximo nivel de volumen y eso me despertaba asustado, en cambio con esta app puedo decidir un intervalo de tiempo en el que la alarma suena desde un volumen bajo hasta el volumen máximo, porque ¿a quién le gusta despertarse nervioso?

title: Perfecta.
body:
Leer reseñas de la gente que no puntúa bien a esta APP es de ser BOBOS.

1. Si la desinstalas OBVIAMENTE va a dejar de sonar. No se que pretende la gente… ¿que manden a un agente de la APP a tu cama y que te de tortazos hasta que te levantes? Pues eso. Que tienes 6 opciones gratuitas para que te levantes sí o sí  y si la borras, se supone que si tienes tiempo para borrarla ya estas despierto.

2. NO ES DE PAGO. Hay una opción que es de pago pero para lo que sirve, no hace falta pagar. Y obviamente hay opciones PREMIUM porque estas aplicaciones las hacen PERSONAS que comen y pagan hipotecas, como tú. Y ese trabajo se valora.

3. La sección noticias SÍ FUNCIONA BIEN, pero vamos, que esto no es El País o El Mundo. Sirve para que te entretengas algo. 

4. SI dejas el móvil en NO MOLESTAR, no te suena. No es difícil de entender que al no ser una APP de APPLE no hay otra forma.

Resumiendo, APP perfecta, te despiertas si o si y a no ser que la borres (como es lógico) sigue sonando y sonando.

P.D.: Usen la “LOUD SOUND 6” suena horrorosamente, se te mete el sonido en el tímpano y te despiertas o parece una tortura, QUE ES PARA LO QUE LA APP ESTÁ HECHA.

Aunque parezca un borde, no lo soy jajaja. Pero me fastidia ver comentarios desperdiciando el trabajo cuando no es así, y es una de las pocas APPS QUE SIN PAGAR dan lo que ofrecen. 

👍🏻😀
